name: lineage_submit_findings
description: Submits or repairs the focus node's SQL findings and neighbor decisions.

focus_node_id.description: Optional. Omit for the current hop; if sent, it must equal focus_node.id from <hop_context>.

column_flow.description: One entry per SQL-proved output related to the arriving columns in <current_task>, with its contributing neighbor columns. Reference only neighbors in <hop_context>. Not sources: row operations (TRUNCATE, DELETE); describe them in sections. [] when nothing feeds the arriving columns. Required for a fresh CT finding; omit to keep the held list on correction. A sent list replaces it whole.

out_col.description: Output column of this hop from its column task; for a procedure, the column it writes. Never invent names.

col.description: Source column name on that node.

transforms.description: Role of this source column: pass_through (unchanged), compute (expression or CASE operand), aggregate (aggregate argument) — its value lands in out_col; combine (join, group, partition or order key) or filter (row predicate) — it only shapes which rows reach out_col. Omit when the SQL does not show the role.

note.description: At most 12 words: the deciding expression, e.g. "Qty * Price".

upstream_columns.description: Neighbor columns that feed out_col: value sources (expression operands, aggregate arguments, each UNION branch column, caller-bound inputs) and columns that only join, filter, group or order its rows. Resolve parameters and aliases to source columns. [] means the value originates here.

summary.description: Required for a fresh finding; omit a saved summary on correction. One sentence, readable without this hop: what this node does to the data and what it hands to which node.

prune_neighbors.description: Optional. A neighbor is either mapped or questioned (kept) or pruned, never both. Name each `can_prune: true` neighbor that supplies neither a value nor a join, filter, group or order column to an output column. A neighbor that does is mapped.

reason.description: What in this node's SQL shows the neighbor is off the answer.

questions.description: Optional. Ask a kept neighbor what its own SQL must answer for the arriving columns: its rules, calculations and thresholds, not only which columns feed this object. Column continuation to mapped neighbors is automatic. A question to an out-of-scope neighbor becomes a follow-up offer. No questions to visited or pruned neighbors.

question.description: The check, self-contained: name the neighbor and what to establish there.

sections.description: Required for a fresh finding; omit held section angles on correction. Pre-formatted section body for the `business` recipe, under key `business`.

business.description: The only angle classification=business keeps; fold any technical content into this key — a separate "technical" key is rejected.

inputSchema.description: A sent questions or prune_neighbors list replaces its held list whole; repeat entries you keep. Omit the list to retain it; [] withdraws it.

name: lineage_get_neighbor_columns
description: Column metadata (types, keys) for direct neighbors of the focus, without SQL. Use it only when the focus SQL hides which neighbor columns it reads (SELECT *, dynamic SQL); a neighbor shown without cols needs no call.
